# qlang Query Answers

I'll work through each task systematically, applying the language constructs demonstrated in the documentation.

H1: /data | map { :name /name :active /active :city /address/city } | select ( /active | eq true ) | select /city | map /name | sort-by ( . | lowercase )

H2: . | select ( /status | lowercase | eq "paid" ) | map /items | flatten | map ( /qty * /price ) | sum | round 2

H3: ( /dependencies | merge /devDependencies ) | entries | select ( /[1] | startsWith "^" ) | map ( /[0] + "@" + /[1] ) | sort

H4: . | select ( /state | eq "open" ) | group-by ( /assignee/login || "unassigned" ) | map-values count

H5: /services | select ( /enabled != false ) | map { :name /name :timeout ( /timeout || 30 ) :retries ( /retries || 3 ) } | sort-by /name

H6: . | select ( /durationMs | . != null ) | group-by /service | map-values ( . | map /durationMs | avg | round 1 )

H7: . | select ( /stock | . | gt 0 ) | sort-by /price | reverse | take 3 | map /name

H8: . | group-by /dept | map-values ( . | map /skills | flatten | compact | map ( . | lowercase ) | distinct | sort )

H9: . | select ( /role | lowercase | eq "db" ) | all ( ( /region | eq "eu-west" ) & ( /cpu/cores | . | gte 8 ) )

H10: split /[,;]/ | map ( . | trim ) | map ( . | split "@" | /[1] | lowercase ) | distinct | sort

H11: . | split /\n/ | map ( . | split " " ) | select ( /[3] | int | gte 500 ) | group-by /[2] | entries | map { :path /[0] :count ( /[1] | count ) } | sort-by ( [ (0 - /count) /path ] ) | take 2

H12: . | split /\n/ | skip 1 | map ( . | split "," ) | select ( /[2] | . ) | group-by /[1] | map-values ( . | map ( /[2] | num ) | avg | round 2 )

H13: . | split /\n/ | select ( . ) | select ( . | startsWith "#" | not ) | select ( . | contains "==" ) | map ( . | split "==" | [ (/[0] | lowercase) /[1] ] ) | from-entries

H14: . | map { :title /title :likes ( ( /comments || [] ) | map ( /likes || 0 ) | sum ) } | sort-by /likes | reverse | /[0] | /title
